ops.body: Native acceptance milestone noted: source-deleted cross-cwd, mapped artifacts, partial tails and interactive rewind pass; cross-config-root is still explicitly NOT COVERED. Please close that remaining acceptance gap if supported local auth can be reused without a new login (inspect existing cc-pool/auth mechanisms; absence of token env vars alone is not proof it is impossible). Any credential used for the test must stay in memory, go only to the normal Claude authentication path, never be logged/committed/synced, and must not modify keychain or the live profile. Do not bypass an explicit access denial; report a concrete remaining approval gate if one occurs. Otherwise retain the limitation honestly rather than calling cross-config recovery verified.
